judgment: Direct state-token custody was repaired in the existing state policy: exact built-in string first, finite source throat second, then normalization/regex/membership semantics.
Backend capability and failure-boundary controls now have finite source throats while preserving accepted exact text; no sanitizer or second policy owner was introduced.
The upstream platform capability classifier received the same exact-but-bounded law for os_name rather than relying on the downstream backend selector to absorb arbitrary direct input.
Hostile fixtures exist for subclass callbacks and max+1 boundaries, but they remain source/unexecuted and therefore cannot authorize TESTED claims.
The existing Warm Wall was mutated in place and its source regression pins touch, keyboard, live-status, SVG, and reduced-motion semantics; runtime TalkBack remains NO.
Exact-head automatic workflows failed and the Operator Overlay job exposed zero steps, so no step-level source diagnosis or manual retry is authorized.
Phone/P0 and duplicate-architecture firewalls remained untouched.
